## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`; its hardcoded default ignores exclusions configured by CI and violates project policy.

## Changes
Adds repeatable `--exclude GLOB` filename filtering, skip logging, documentation, and tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Honor ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE when --exclude is omitted — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, you still archive `.log` files because the default is always `[]`. This violates `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment include files they explicitly intended to leave out of their archives.
